contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Tetricus II (272-274), probably an irregular issue on a small oval flan, Reece period 13. Obverse description; Radiate head right. Obverse inscription: [--]TETRIC[--]. Reverse description: Stick figure standing left with right arm extended. Diameter: 16.2mm, Weight: 2.18gms, die axis: 9
